hypotheses.title: Palmostatin B Extends Lifespan in C. elegans
hypotheses.claim: Treatment with palmostatin B extends the lifespan of Caenorhabditis elegans. The compound increases median and maximal survival relative to untreated controls.
hypotheses.rationale: Modulating protein depalmitoylation can correct signaling localization and reduce age-related cellular dysfunction. Such restoration of proteostasis may slow aging in C. elegans.
hypotheses.prediction: Palmostatin B–treated worms will show a statistically significant increase in median and maximum lifespan compared with vehicle-treated controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Synchronize worm populations, treat one cohort with palmostatin B and one with vehicle from the young adult stage, and perform a blinded survival assay with Kaplan–Meier analysis.

hypotheses.title: Resveratrol Extends Lifespan in C. elegans
hypotheses.claim: Treatment with resveratrol extends the lifespan of Caenorhabditis elegans. The polyphenol increases median and maximal survival relative to untreated controls.
hypotheses.rationale: Resveratrol activates sirtuin-linked stress responses and mimics caloric restriction at the cellular level. These conserved pathways can slow aging in C. elegans.
hypotheses.prediction: Resveratrol-treated worms will show a statistically significant increase in median and maximum lifespan compared with vehicle-treated controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Synchronize worm populations, treat one cohort with resveratrol and one with vehicle from the young adult stage, and perform a blinded survival assay with Kaplan–Meier analysis.

hypotheses.prediction: NSC666076-treated worms will show a statistically significant increase in median and maximum lifespan compared with vehicle-treated controls.

hypotheses.title: D-Xylitol Extends Lifespan in C. elegans
hypotheses.claim: Supplementation with D-xylitol extends the lifespan of Caenorhabditis elegans. The sugar alcohol increases median and maximal survival relative to untreated controls.
hypotheses.rationale: D-xylitol alters carbohydrate metabolism and may promote mild metabolic stress that activates longevity pathways. Such metabolic conditioning can extend survival in C. elegans.
hypotheses.prediction: D-xylitol-supplemented worms will show a statistically significant increase in median and maximum lifespan compared with unsupplemented controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Synchronize worm populations, supplement one cohort's agar plates with D-xylitol and one with vehicle from the young adult stage, and perform a blinded survival assay with Kaplan–Meier analysis.

hypotheses.title: Resveratrol Extends Lifespan via DAF-2 Pathway Activation
hypotheses.claim: Resveratrol extends the lifespan of Caenorhabditis elegans by activating the insulin/IGF-1 receptor DAF-2 pathway. The effect on survival depends on DAF-2 signaling activity.
hypotheses.rationale: The DAF-2 pathway controls conserved downstream effectors of aging, including FOXO-dependent stress responses. Modulation of this receptor can therefore reshape lifespan in C. elegans.
hypotheses.prediction: Resveratrol will fail to extend lifespan in daf-2 loss-of-function mutants while extending lifespan in wild-type worms.
hypotheses.experiment: Treat wild-type and daf-2 mutant worms with resveratrol or vehicle, run parallel lifespan assays, and compare the magnitude of lifespan extension across genotypes.

hypotheses.title: NSC666076 Extends Lifespan via PARP Inhibition
hypotheses.claim: NSC666076 extends the lifespan of Caenorhabditis elegans by inhibiting poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase and reducing NAD+ depletion. The effect on survival depends on PARP activity.
hypotheses.rationale: PARP enzymes consume NAD+ during DNA repair, and excessive NAD+ loss impairs mitochondrial function and sirtuin signaling. Limiting this consumption can preserve metabolic fitness during aging in C. elegans.
hypotheses.prediction: NSC666076 will maintain higher NAD+ levels and extend lifespan in wild-type worms, but not in worms with constitutively low PARP activity.
hypotheses.experiment: Measure NAD+ concentrations and perform lifespan assays in wild-type and PARP-deficient worms treated with NSC666076 or vehicle, and compare outcomes across groups.

hypotheses.title: Resveratrol Shortens Lifespan in C. elegans
hypotheses.claim: Treatment with resveratrol shortens the lifespan of Caenorhabditis elegans. The compound decreases median and maximal survival relative to untreated controls.
hypotheses.rationale: Resveratrol can disrupt metabolic homeostasis and impose bioenergetic stress at effective doses. Such stress may accelerate functional decline in C. elegans.
hypotheses.prediction: Resveratrol-treated worms will show a statistically significant decrease in median and maximum lifespan compared with vehicle-treated controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Synchronize worm populations, treat one cohort with resveratrol and one with vehicle from the young adult stage, and perform a blinded survival assay with Kaplan–Meier analysis.

hypotheses.title: NSC666076 Shortens Lifespan in C. elegans
hypotheses.claim: Treatment with NSC666076 shortens the lifespan of Caenorhabditis elegans. The compound decreases median and maximal survival relative to untreated controls.
